title: Full Time Direct Response Copywriter for US Women's Supplement Brand (Meta Ads, Landing Pages, Advertorials)
description:
About us



Celestials is a fast-growing US supplement brand for women. Our products are herbal supplements: Fenugreek 3000MG, the Glow Stack and Black Garlic CoQ10. We sell online through Meta ads, and we launch new ads every week.



This is a full-time role on our team. You will write for one brand only, which means you will get to know our customers, our products and what sells better than anyone.



What you will do



Write Meta ad copy: primary text, headlines, hooks and on-image text for static ads

Write video ad scripts: UGC scripts, voiceover scripts, hooks and video sales letters (VSLs)

Write landing pages, product pages, advertorials and listicles

Write native long-form ads (first-person stories, 1,000+ words) that sound like a real woman telling her story, not a brand

Dig through customer reviews, Reddit, comments and competitor ads to find the exact words our customers use

Turn that research into new angles, hooks and offers to test

Write many variations of one idea fast, so we can test what works

Rewrite copy based on ad results and feedback from our creative team

Who you will write for



Our customers are US women. Many are dealing with things they find embarrassing or hard to talk about: body confidence, changes after pregnancy, hormone changes, blood pressure and medication side effects. Our audience also includes trans women.



You need to write about these topics with empathy and in their own words, without being clinical, preachy or awkward. You also need to know the rules for supplement advertising: no medical claims, no promises we can't back up, nothing Meta will reject.



What you must know



You must be strong in the foundations of direct response copywriting. In your application or interview, we will ask you about:



Awareness levels (Eugene Schwartz): how copy changes for someone who does not know they have a problem vs. someone ready to buy

Market sophistication: what to do when the market has heard every claim before

Mechanism: explaining WHY a product works in a way that is new and believable

Hooks and headlines: stopping the scroll and making someone read the next line

Avatar and customer research: writing from real customer language, not guesses

Offers, objections and proof: handling doubt, price and "will this work for me?"

Frameworks like PAS, AIDA and the classic sales letter structure, and knowing when to break them

If you have studied Schwartz, Ogilvy, Hopkins, Halbert, Sugarman, Gary Bencivenga or Stefan Georgi, tell us what you took from them.



Requirements



2+ years writing direct response copy (ads, landing pages,
s, VSLs or advertorials)

A portfolio with real work, ideally with results (CTR, ROAS, conversion rate, sales)

Experience writing for supplement, health or beauty brands

Excellent written English. Native-level, natural, casual when needed. US English spelling

You can write the way a real person talks. No corporate language, no fluff, no hype words

You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up research and drafts, but you never ship raw AI copy. You know what AI copy sounds like and you remove it

Fast, reliable and fine with direct feedback and rewrites

Stable internet and a quiet place to work

Nice to have



Experience with Meta ads and knowing what makes an ad perform (hook rate, CTR, ROAS)

Experience writing UGC scripts for creators

You know Meta's ad rules for health and supplement products

Familiar with Notion, Google Docs and Slack

Why work with us



Long-term, stable, full-time role with a growing brand

One brand, so you go deep instead of juggling ten clients

You see the real results of your copy every week and learn fast from the data

Direct work with the founders and creative team

Fully remote, flexible hours

How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



Start your application with the words "Ugly copy sells" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

Your portfolio or 3 to 5 samples of direct response copy (ads, landing pages, VSL scripts or advertorials). Tell us what each one was for and how it performed if you know.

Short answers to these 3 questions (write them yourself, no AI):

What is the difference between writing for a problem-aware customer and a product-aware customer?

Pick one supplement or health ad you have seen recently that you think sells well. Why does it work?

Write 3 hooks for a
 ad selling a natural supplement to a woman in her 40s who has felt tired every day since starting blood pressure medication.

Your expected monthly salary in USD.

title: Multi-Platform Video Editor (Per-Video Pay) – Fast Turnaround, Excellent English
description:
We're Unlocking Language, a London speech and language therapy company (50+ therapists, 100+ schools and clinics). We publish videos for parents, schools and therapists on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn. We need a video editor who can take raw footage and a written brief and send back finished, platform-ready videos fast.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit raw footage (talking-head, screen recordings, webinars, clinic b-roll) into polished videos

- Deliver platform cuts from one master: 16:9 for YouTube/LinkedIn, 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, 1:1 where needed

- Add burned-in captions in UK English, on-brand titles, lower thirds, music, sound clean-up

- Cut long videos into batches of short clips with strong hooks

- Turn around short-form in 24 hours and long-form in 48 hours



PAY

Paid per video, not per hour. Indicative rates (USD):

- Short-form clip (under 90s): $10–15

- Batch of 5 short clips from one long video: $45–60

- Long-form edit (5–15 min): $35–60

- Long-form edit (15–40 min): $60–100

Paid after each video is approved. Steady weekly work for the right person, with rates reviewed after 3 months.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years editing for social platforms, with a portfolio to prove it

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (CapCut Pro acceptable for short-form)

- Excellent written English — you will caption UK speech with clinical terms, so accuracy matters

- A fast, reliable PC/Mac and internet (you'll be handling 1–5GB files)

- Availability to respond within UK working hours (9am–6pm London)



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Applications that skip any of the steps below are deleted unread.



1. Put the word BLUEBELL as the first word of your application.

2. Link to 3 videos YOU edited, in this format: Link / Platform / Your exact role / Software used / Turnaround time. Include at least one 9:16 short with captions and one 16:9 long-form edit. Links to private or unavailable videos are not counted.

3. Link to your full portfolio (YouTube channel, Google Drive, Behance, your site).

4. Answer in 2–3 sentences: a client sends you a 40-minute webinar recording and wants 5 Reels by tomorrow. Describe your exact workflow from download to delivery.

5. Tell us your per-video rate for (a) a 60-second captioned Reel and (b) a 10-minute YouTube edit, and how many videos you can complete per week.

6. Confirm you can complete a short test edit (a 2–3 minute clip into a 30-second Reel, under an hour's work) within 24 hours of receiving it this week.



Shortlisted applicants get the test brief. Pass that and you start on real, paid per-video work straight away.

title: Accounts & Administration Officer
description:
Job title: Remote Bookkeeper & Accounts Administrator (Xero) — Australian Forestry, Agriculture & Drone Group — Full Time

Job type: Full Time, long-term · Hours: 9:30am–5:30pm Melbourne time (AEDT), Monday to Friday · Salary: $12/hr AUD [PHP 537/hr - 90,090/month] · Start: In two weeks

About us

Rencon Group is a Melbourne-based Australian company with two operating brands: Rencon Air & Land (aerial surveys, koala and native species monitoring, forestry services) and DRONES180 (DJI Enterprise and AGRAS drone sales and services). We run field crews across Victoria and New South Wales (incl Inter-state) and work with large forestry and agricultural clients. We are a small, fast-moving business — the Director is hands-on and needs an accounts person who can run the day-to-day finance function without being chased.

The role

You will own our bookkeeping, invoicing, payroll processing and accounts administration across two Australian companies in Xero. Getting invoices out the day a job finishes and getting them paid is the single most important part of this job — our cash flow depends on it.

What you will do

• Raise customer invoices in Xero from crew timesheets and work completion reports; set invoices up in draft before the job finishes so they are ready to send on completion

• Chase crews and supervisors for timesheets and job details — follow up until you have what you need

• Call Australian customers by phone to follow up overdue invoices (many of our rural clients do not respond to
)

• Submit invoices to our invoice-finance provider before the daily 2:00pm cut-off

• Process weekly payroll in Xero Payroll (timesheets, leave accruals, superannuation, child-support deductions, wage advances, final pays)

• Load supplier bills for payment through Airwallex, addressed to the correct company entity

• Reconcile bank feeds and customer remittances in Xero daily

• Keep our job pipeline (RenHQ) up to date so quotes, jobs and invoices stay in sync

• Prepare WorkCover remuneration and other compliance information with our external accountants

• General admin: shared accounts inbox, supplier and customer queries, staff onboarding paperwork

You must have

• 3+ years bookkeeping for Australian small businesses, including Xero Payroll, superannuation and BAS-ready books

• Excellent spoken and written English — you will phone Australian customers and staff and write to them daily

• Proactive, persistent follow-up: you chase information, flag problems early and tell us when something is ready for approval — you do not wait to be asked

• Accuracy on repeat tasks: same invoice format, right entity, right account, every time

• Full-time availability during Melbourne business hours, quiet workspace, reliable internet and backup power

Nice to have: Airwallex, invoice finance (Optipay or similar), Zoho Bigin or another CRM, Microsoft 365 / Teams, experience with trades, forestry, agriculture or field-service businesses.

How to apply

Send your CV plus short answers to these three questions: (1) Describe how you would make sure every finished job is invoiced the same day. (2) A customer is 30 days overdue and ignoring
s — what do you do, step by step? (3) What Xero Payroll processes have you run end to end? Put the word KOALA in your subject line so we know you read the ad. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a short paid Xero test and a video call.

description:
We're looking for an outbound demand generation specialist to generate sales opportunities via
. You'll own the full outbound motion: identifying the right accounts and contacts, building clean targeted lists, designing multi-channel cadences, writing outreach that gets replies, and booking qualified meetings for our sales team.



This role is ideal for someone who loves the mechanics of outbound, from data quality and deliverability to copywriting and testing, and who measures success in pipeline, not activity.



What You'll Do

List Building and Research

Define and refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and buyer personas with sales and leadership.

Build targeted account and contact lists using tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, or similar.

Enrich, verify, and clean contact data to keep bounce rates low and accuracy high.

Segment lists by industry, company size, role, trigger events, and intent signals.

Research accounts to find relevant personalization angles (funding, hiring, tech stack, news).

Cadence Design and Outreach

Build multi-step, multi-channel sequences combining
, LinkedIn, and phone.

Write clear, concise, personalized outreach copy for each persona and segment.

Run A/B tests on subject lines, messaging, offers, and timing, and iterate based on results.

Manage replies promptly, handle objections, and book meetings onto sales calendars.

Make cold calls and follow-up calls during US business hours.

Deliverability and Systems

Set up and maintain sending domains and inboxes, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and warm-up.

Monitor sender reputation, bounce rates, and spam placement.

Manage sequences in a sales engagement platform (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist).

Keep the CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive) accurate and up to date with every touch and outcome.

Ensure outreach complies with CAN-SPAM, GDPR (where applicable), and platform policies.

Reporting and Optimization

Track and report weekly on key metrics: lists built,
s sent, open/reply rates, positive replies, meetings booked, and meetings held.

Analyze what's working by segment, persona, and message, and recommend changes.

Work closely with sales to gather feedback on lead quality and improve targeting.



What We're Looking For (Required)

2+ years of experience in B2B outbound, SDR/BDR, or demand generation roles.

Hands-on experience with list building and data enrichment tools.

Proven track record of building cadences that generate replies and booked meetings.

Strong written English and the ability to write concise, persuasive copy.

Comfortable on the phone and confident speaking with senior decision-makers.

Working knowledge of
 deliverability best practices.

Experience with at least one CRM and one sales engagement platform.

Ability to work reliably during US business hours.

Organized, self-directed, and data-driven.

Full-time, US business hours : 7am–4pm ET





Nice to Have

Experience with Clay or other workflow-based enrichment tools.

Background selling into [your target industry, e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, eCommerce].

Experience with intent data (e.g., Bombora, G2 Buyer Intent, 6sense).

Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach strategies and social selling.

Experience setting up outbound infrastructure from scratch.

How Success Is Measured

Qualified meetings booked and held per month

Pipeline generated from outbound

Positive reply rate and bounce rate

List accuracy and CRM data quality

Continuous improvement through testing

Performance bonus per qualified meeting or pipeline target

title: Node.js Developer (Full-Time): Keep Our Live Systems Running
description:
We’re a small, profitable media company. We run our YouTube production through our own web portal (research, an AI video editor, copyright checks, translation, task tracking), and we’re building a second product next to it. Both are large, mostly AI-built, and live in production. We need an engineer who keeps them healthy, checks what the AI writes, and helps them grow.



Hours: 40 h/week, overlapping 10:00 to 18:00 Philippine time.

Salary: USD $1,000–$1,200/month, depending on experience.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Investigate and fix bugs from Sentry and from the team, prioritizing urgent issues during your hours.

- Write tests and help keep our production systems reliable.

- Build small features from written specs as tested, reviewed PRs.

- First project: write the architecture and setup docs.



Initially, you’ll focus on bug fixes, tests, documentation, and small features. The founder retains deployment decisions and provides backup for production i
. Your ownership will grow as you learn the systems and demonstrate reliable delivery.



STACK



- Node.js 20 (Express, ES modules), PostgreSQL, plain HTML/JS plus a React/TypeScript editor, Docker on Railway, GitHub Actions, Sentry.

- Some Python, FFmpeg, yt-dlp.

- APIs: Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, YouTube, Trello, 
, Dropbox.



YOU HAVE



- 3+ years of Node.js in production, and solid Postgres/SQL.

- Experience debugging live systems down to the root cause.

- Experience working in a large codebase you didn’t write.

- The habit of writing tests and keeping PRs small.

- Good written English.

- Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex), and you can check their output.



Nice to have: Python, FFmpeg/video, Docker, LLM APIs.



HOW WE HIRE



1. Written application.

2. A 20-minute call.

3. A paid test task (4 to 8 hours) on a real bug.

4. A 2-week paid trial, then a 3-month contract with 30-day notice.



You sign an NDA and an IP agreement, and all code goes through reviewed PRs.



TO APPLY



Start your message with “Production bug:” and answer:



1. A production bug you fixed: what broke, the root cause, how you found it, and how you stopped it happening again.

2. Which AI coding tools you use, and how you check their code.

3. A link to your GitHub or something you built.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that don’t start with “Production bug:” or skip the questions won’t be read.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Video Creator / Editor: Heritage Health (DTC Supplement Startup)



(PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE THING)



What the job is:



We make organic short-form videos with Higgsfield. You’ll be producing 10-15 videos a day, each 10-15 seconds long. The edits are simple. What matters is how good you are at prompting and how fast you move.



Who you are:



20-28, young but proven. You’ve already got real reps. You’ve made AI videos that actually got views, and you’re still hungry with everything to prove.

You’re a prompting machine. You know Higgsfield inside and out (Seedance, Kling, image models, Genjutsu swaps) and you can get the shot you want in a few generations, not thirty. You know how to write a prompt that comes back looking real, not “AI-y.”

You live on TikTok and Reels. You know what’s trending, what hooks stop the scroll in the first second, and why one 12-second video does 2 million views while another does 400.

You’re fast. Short videos with simple edits mean volume is the game. 10-15 a day shouldn’t scare you.

You think for yourself. I don’t want to hold your hand. I want someone who comes to me with video ideas and new formats instead of waiting to be told what to make.

You know ecom and you’re tapped into the brands winning right now: Resilia, Lymphoria, Ryze, IM8. You understand what their organic content is doing and why it works.

You want to change your life. You’re ready to put your head down and grind 12+ hour days behind the laptop, locked in with a team that wants it just as bad, building something real from scratch.



Now the part I care about just as much:



I’ve hired people before who killed it on paper and then disappeared. Took a full day to answer a message. Moved slow. Weren’t hungry. Didn’t take it seriously. I’m done with that. I need someone who messages back fast, who’s genuinely willing to put in 12+ hour days, and who treats this like it’s theirs. If you’re lazy, if you ghost, if you need to be chased, don’t apply.



And straight up, if you don’t fit all of these requirements, don’t waste my time and don’t waste your time.



To apply: drop your WhatsApp and Instagram below, plus 3-5 of your best AI-generated short-form videos. For at least one of them, include the exact prompt you used.

title: AI Automation Engineer (E-commerce)
description:
About the role

We are looking for a freelance AI Automation Engineer to build and run an agent system that operates our Shopify dropshipping business 24/7, with minimal human input.

We are a European e-commerce company with 7 years in Shopify dropshipping and more than 250 stores built. We run fashion stores for Europe (France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland, Denmark and more) and for the US and Canada. Today a human team handles the daily chain: product research, listing, creatives and ad launches. We want AI agents to take over most of that chain.

You live in the world of agentic AI. You know Claude, ChatGPT, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent inside out, and you have shipped agents that run on a server without babysitting. You design and build the system and hand it over fully working. One human controller on our side reviews and approves the key decisions.

• Type: freelance gig, project-based

• Location: fully remote

• Hours: flexible, with some overlap in the evening (CET)

The mission

Build five agents that run our daily chain on a server, around the clock.

Each agent hands its output to the next. The one fixed human step is a single approval before money is spent on ads.

What you will build

You own the system end to end, across five stages.

1. Product research

    ◦ Connect agents to Winninghunter (MCP/API) and scan daily for winning products, scaling ads and competitor stores.

    ◦ Score products on clear criteria: ad longevity, engagement, number of stores selling it, margin and shipping.

    ◦ Deliver a daily shortlist with the reasoning behind each pick.

2. Product launch

    ◦ Create products and collections in Shopify automatically via the Admin API or Shopify MCP.

    ◦ Generate product photos with AI (e.g. Higgsfield), plus titles, descriptions, variants and pricing.

    ◦ Write copy in the language of each market (French, Dutch, Polish, Danish, English).

    ◦ Apply the right conversion strategy: offers, bundles, upsells, social proof and page structure.

3. Creatives

    ◦ Turn competitor winning ads into new concepts: hooks, angles and offers.

    ◦ Design static and video ad creatives with AI image and video tools, in all needed formats.

    ◦ Write headlines and ad copy per market.

4. Ad launch

    ◦ Launch campaigns through the Meta Marketing API (Meta Ads MCP), with fixed naming, budgets and testing structure.

    ◦ Build in approval gates and hard spend limits, so no money goes out without the rules allowing it.

5. Deep analysis

    ◦ Pull ad metrics and Shopify orders daily and calculate real profit per product and per ad.

    ◦ Apply kill and scale rules, spot creative fatigue and suggest next tests.

    ◦ Feed the learnings back into research and creatives, so the system gets better every week.

Across all stages you also handle orchestration, logging, monitoring, error handling, API cost control, key security and clear documentation.

Tech stack

This is what we use today; you are free to propose better choices.

Area

Tools

AI models

Claude (API, Claude Code, Agent SDK), OpenAI / ChatGPT

Agent frameworks

OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, MCP servers

Product research

Winninghunter

Store

Shopify (Admin GraphQL API, Shopify MCP)

Creatives

Higgsfield and other AI image/video tools

Ads

Meta Ads (Marketing API / MCP), later TikTok Ads

Infrastructure

Linux server (VPS or cloud), Docker, Python and/or Node.js

Shared workspace

Google Drive and Google Sheets

Must-haves

• At least 2 years of hands-on work with LLM APIs, including agent systems running in production. You can show them.

• Deep knowledge of the Claude and OpenAI APIs: tool use, function calling, MCP, prompt design and context management.

• Hands-on experience with OpenClaw and/or Hermes Agent, and you can explain when to use which.

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, plus REST and GraphQL APIs and webhooks.

• Linux server skills: Docker, process managers, cron or queues, logging, monitoring and backups for 24/7 uptime.

• Experience with the Shopify Admin API and the Meta Marketing API.

• You understand e-commerce, not just code: what makes a winning product, what converts, and Meta metrics like CTR, CPM, CPC, CPA and ROAS.

• A security mindset: secrets management, scoped permissions and spend limits.

• Clear written English. You document everything you build.

• You work independently and proactively, without daily hand-holding.

Nice to have

• You have run a dropshipping store or bought Meta ads yourself.

• Experience with AI image and video tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney, Runway or Kling.

• Experience with spy tools like Winninghunter, Minea or PiPiADS.

• Copywriting skills in French, Dutch, Polish or Danish.

• Experience with the TikTok Ads API.

• Experience building evals to test prompt and agent quality.

• You can build simple dashboards for reporting and approvals.

Project milestones

Within 2 weeks, the full chain from research to analysis runs on the server, with a human only approving the key steps.

Phase

Deliverable

Done when

Milestone 1 (days 1–4)

Server live; research agent and product launch agent working

A daily product shortlist arrives automatically, and approved products go live in Shopify with photos and copy

Milestone 2 (days 5–9)

Creative agent and ad launch agent working

Creatives and campaigns are built automatically and launch after one approval, within spend limits

Milestone 3 (days 10–14)

Analysis agent and feedback loop working; documentation done

Daily profit reports, kill/scale suggestions and learnings flow back into research and creatives

What we offer

• A clear project with real ownership: you design the architecture.

• A competitive project fee, based on experience.

• Full access to the tools and API budget you need.

• Direct contact with the owner: short lines, fast decisions.

• A real business with real data, so you see the impact of your work right away.

• Fully remote, flexible hours.

How to apply

Send your application with the word AUTOPILOT in the subject line. Applications without it are not read.

Include:

1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. A short video (max 5 minutes, e.g. Loom) walking through an agent system you built and that runs in production.

3. Answers to these questions (max 1 page):

    ◦ How would you architect the five-stage pipeline above? Which tools would you use where?

    ◦ Which steps would you keep human-in-the-loop, and why?

    ◦ What would you estimate the monthly running cost to be (server plus API usage)?

    ◦ How do you prevent an agent from wasting ad budget when something goes wrong?

4. Your project quote (fixed price or hourly rate), estimated timeline and availability.

title: Virtual Dental Patient Coordinator (Remote – Full-Time)
description:
# Virtual Dental Patient Coordinator (Remote – Full-Time)



**40 Hours per Week | Monday–Friday | US Central Time**



**Location:** Remote  

**Industry:** US Dental Practice  

**Experience:** Minimum 1 year supporting a US medical or dental practice



## About the Opportunity



We are a growing, technology-driven dental practice in Texas looking for an exceptional **Virtual Dental Patient Coordinator** to join our team.



We are not looking for someone who simply answers phones, follows scripts, and waits for instructions.



We are looking for someone who **takes ownership of conversations, thinks ahead, solves problems, and knows how to turn patient inquiries into scheduled appointments.**



You will often be the first person a patient speaks with, so your communication skills, professionalism, and ability to build trust are essential.



Our practice has established systems, detailed training materials, and standardized procedures. We can teach you our software and workflows. What we need you to bring is **excellent English, reliability, initiative, and confidence communicating with American patients.**



## What You'll Be Doing



### 1. Patient Communication & Appointment Conversion

- Answer inbound calls and respond promptly to patient text messages.

- Build rapport with patients through natural, confident conversations.

- Help patients understand their next steps and guide them toward scheduling.

- Handle patient questions, concerns, and objections professionally.

- Follow up with interested patients who have not yet scheduled.

- Communicate clearly without sounding robotic, overly scripted, or passive.



### 2. Scheduling & Patient Reactivation

- Schedule hygiene appointments, consultations, and other eligible visits.

- Contact overdue patients and encourage them to return for recommended care.

- Follow up on missed appointments and outstanding scheduling opportunities.

- Identify gaps in the schedule and proactively help fill them.

- Maintain accurate patient records and appointment information.



### 3. Emergency Patient Coordination

- Respond confidently to urgent dental inquiries, including broken teeth, toothaches, and other dental concerns.

- Ask the appropriate questions using established emergency call protocols.

- Identify when an inquiry requires immediate clinical escalation.

- Help patients understand their scheduling options without providing medical advice.



### 4. Insurance, Billing & Payments

- Verify dental insurance eligibility and benefits online.

- Coordinate with the Insurance Coordinator when additional assistance is needed.

- Send virtual invoices and securely facilitate payments through Clover.

- Explain administrative billing information clearly and professionally.

- Escalate complicated financial questions when necessary.



### 5. Team Communication & Accountability

- Communicate promptly with the in-office and virtual teams through Google Chat.

- Participate in Google Meet video calls with your camera on when required.

- Provide proactive updates on assigned responsibilities and unresolved issues.

- Follow established SOPs and maintain accurate documentation.

- Take responsibility for completing tasks without repeated reminders.



## What We're Looking For



**Exceptional English Communication**



You must be able to understand and comfortably converse with fast-speaking American patients, including patients who are upset, confused, or in a hurry.



We are looking for someone with a clear, professional phone presence who can communicate naturally, ask thoughtful questions, and confidently guide a conversation.



**Proactive, Not Reactive**



You don't wait for someone to tell you every next step. You recognize opportunities, anticipate problems, follow through, and communicate before being asked.



**Confident but Friendly**



You can be warm and empathetic without being timid. You are comfortable taking the lead in a conversation, providing clear direction, and helping patients make decisions.



**Dependable and Responsive**



Attendance, punctuality, and responsiveness are non-negotiable. Our patients and team depend on you being available and engaged throughout your scheduled shift.



**Detail-Oriented and Organized**



You can manage multiple conversations, maintain accurate records, and follow procedures without losing important details.



## Mandatory Qualifications



- Minimum 1 year of recent experience supporting a US-based medical or dental practice.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Demonstrated experience handling patient calls and appointment scheduling.

- Strong ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy.

- Reliable attendance and consistent responsiveness.

- Willingness to work 40 hours weekly, Monday through Friday, during US Central Time business hours.

- Exclusive professional commitment to our practice during scheduled working hours.

- Willingness to attend video meetings with camera enabled.



**Technical Requirements**

- Dedicated, quiet home office.

- Intel Core i5 processor or comparable performance (Apple M2 or newer).

- Minimum 16 GB RAM.

- Stable, high-speed internet connection.

- Reliable headset and microphone suitable for professional patient calls.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required:



- Open Dental

- GoHighLevel (CRM, calling, and texting)

- Clover payment processing

- Dental insurance verification

- Dental hygiene recall and patient reactivation

- Dental appointment scheduling and emergency call handling

- Google Chat and Google Meet



## What Makes Someone Successful Here?



The strongest candidates are people who:



- Enjoy speaking with patients and building relationships.

- Know how to ask good questions rather than simply provide information.

- Can turn a hesitant caller into a confidently scheduled patient without pressuring them.

- Take pride in helping the practice grow.

- Communicate problems early and bring possible solutions.

- Learn quickly and appreciate structured training.

- Value accountability, professionalism, and being part of a dependable team.



**This is not a passive data-entry or basic call-answering position.** It is an opportunity to become an important part of a dental practice where your communication skills, judgment, and initiative directly influence the patient experience.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated resume highlighting US medical or dental experience.

2. A 60–90 second video introduction in English explaining your previous patient communication responsibilities and why you would be successful in this position.

3. A brief description of your experience with appointment scheduling, patient reactivation, and insurance verification.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Confirmation that you can work full-time during US Central Time hours.



**Candidates selected for the next stage will complete a live patient communication exercise and a practical skills assessment.**

5. Your price for a complete 10–15 minute video.

Our starting budget is around $50–$70 per video, and we're aiming for a 3-day turnaround when all materials are ready.



We prefer reviewing a watermarked preview before paying for and receiving the final files. Payment terms will be agreed before starting.

I'm not looking for the cheapest editor or someone who just knows how to cut clips together. I want someone who understands YouTube, has real experience, and can show me work that proves it.

Full-time · Remote · £750 per month · UK air conditioning company



ABOUT THE ROLE



We design and install air conditioning in private homes, mostly in London. After every site survey, the engineer records a voice note walking through each room. That note becomes an AI-generated transcript, and it is often rough, with unclear wording and the occasional contradiction.



The main part of your job is turning that transcript into the written quotation the homeowner receives. It should be accurate, easy to follow, and persuasive enough to win the job. The customer is usually comparing us against other quotes, and nobody from the company is in the room when they read it. Your writing does the selling.

Quotations and writing

▪ Checking every room, item and price against the survey so nothing is missed, added or double counted, and the total adds up

▪ Spotting anything unclear or contradictory and raising it rather than guessing

▪ Improving the written English of quotations and client
s drafted by the technical team



Admin and client communication

▪ Managing and replying to client
s

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



▪ Excellent written English, with a background in copywriting, content writing, journalism, proposals or similar

▪ Able to persuade, not just describe. You can write for one specific reader who is about to spend a lot of money

▪ Comfortable with admin work and happy to do it alongside the writing

▪ Very strong attention to detail, and comfortable working with figures

▪ Writing that is genuinely your own. This role is not suited to anyone who relies on AI tools to write

▪ Fully committed to a long-term, full-time role, and ready to start soon

▪ Reliable, organized, and able to work independently once trained

NICE TO HAVE



▪ Experience writing quotations, proposals or sales copy sent to individual clients

title: Local SEO & Google Business Profile Specialist — Marketing Automation
description:
Spark Pest Control is looking for a hands-on Local SEO and Google Business Profile specialist who also understands CRM workflows, marketing automation, and lead follow-up.



We serve homeowners and businesses in Gilbert and the surrounding Phoenix East Valley in Arizona. Our priority is to generate more qualified local inquiries and improve the systems that help our team respond, follow up, and book appointments.



You’ll work directly with the owner, focus on one business, and have room to investigate problems, recommend priorities, and implement improvements.



**The role**



Local SEO and Google Business Profile will be your primary responsibility. Automation will be a defined part of the role, with projects prioritized around the available hours.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands the connection between local visibility, lead capture, follow-up, and customer acquisition.



**Local SEO and Google Business Profile**



• Audit our Google Business Profile, website, local visibility, and competitors.

• Identify and prioritize opportunities across Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, and surrounding service areas.

• Improve GBP categories, services, business information, photos, and review-request processes.

• Optimize WordPress service pages, location content, internal links, and on-page SEO.

• Identify and resolve technical SEO issues within your capabilities.

• Improve business listings, citation accuracy, and relevant local links.

• Use Google Search Console, GA4, and local SEO tools to measure progress.

• Provide concise reporting on completed work, qualified leads, findings, and next priorities.



**Marketing automation and integrations**



We already use several tools to manage calls, leads, scheduling, and customer communication. We need someone who can understand those systems and help improve how they work together.



Projects may include:



• Connecting forms and lead sources to follow-up workflows.

• Building or improving Make scenarios, webhooks, and API integrations.

• Automating internal notifications, reminders, and reporting.

• Supporting estimate follow-up, customer reactivation, and review requests.

• Troubleshooting existing workflows and preventing duplicate or missed actions.

• Documenting and testing automations so our team can maintain them.



Our environment includes WordPress, Make, PestPac, Five9, CallRail, and Microsoft Teams. Experience with GoHighLevel is welcome, especially if you have also built integrations outside GHL. Familiarity with every platform is less important than your ability to understand and improve an existing setup.



**What we’re looking for**



• Demonstrated Local SEO and GBP results for home-service or other local businesses.

• Ability to personally implement website and SEO improvements.

• Practical experience with Make, Zapier, CRM workflows, or similar automation tools.

• Clear communication, sound prioritization, and reliable follow-through.

• Ability to work independently, estimate effort, and explain what you need from us.

• A focus on qualified inquiries and business results.



Your primary SEO measure will be qualified leads generated through organic search and Google Business Profile. Our sales team owns converting those opportunities; your automation work will help support that process.



**Hours and compensation**



This position starts at approximately 20 hours per week at $15–$16 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience. Some overlap with Arizona business hours is needed for coordination.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. One or two examples of local SEO work you personally completed, including the starting situation, your actions, timeframe, and measurable results.

2. An example of an automation you built, including the tools involved, the problem it solved, and your personal contribution. Screenshots or a short walkthrough are welcome; please remove confidential client information.

3. Your availability, desired hourly rate, and whether a 20-hour/week starting schedule works for you. This role could easily graduate into full-time 40 hours per week.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.

title: Client Services & Production Manager
description:
About Creation Station Printing

Creation Station Printing is a print and promotional products company based in Austin, Texas, with locations in Houston and Dallas. For about 10 years we have produced business cards, flyers, banners, signs, apparel and branded promo items for businesses, from local companies to corporate accounts.



We print in-house and through a network of trusted trade printers and suppliers. Customers order through our online store, by quote and through direct ordering connections, so every order has to land on time, whoever makes it.



The role

You own every order from the moment a customer approves a quote until it is delivered, on time and as promised.



Half the job is leading customer service. You are the person customers trust for order status, realistic timelines and fast fixes. The other half is outsourcing and production coordination. You buy from our vendor network, pass approved artwork from our art team to whoever is printing it, keep every job moving on the production calendar, and catch delays before they reach the customer.



Customer service leadership (about 50%)

You are the main contact for our business customers on every open order, and you lead the customer service team.



Own open orders. Answer customers on status, changes and delivery dates.

Set accurate expectations. At quote and at order, give turnaround and ship dates that production and vendors can actually meet.

Warn before customers ask. When a job slips, tell the customer before the due date, with a new date and a plan.

Quote with judgment. Review and send quotes. When a request is vague or incomplete, pick the right product and options and ask the right questions.

Fix problems fully. Handle misprints, damaged shipments, reprints, refunds and partial refunds, then fix the cause.

Serve corporate accounts. Handle purchase order numbers, approval steps and recurring orders for business customers.

Lead the team. Set daily priorities, keep response times fast in the shared inbox and help desk, coach new staff, and keep our how-to guides current.

Outsourcing and production coordination (about 50%)

You d
 where each job gets made, buy it at the right cost, and keep it moving until it ships.



Outsourcing and purchasing

Pick the right vendor. Choose the right trade printer or supplier for each outsourced job, on price, quality, turnaround and shipping, using our vendor list.

Get custom pricing. Request quotes from vendors for jobs our website or vendor sites can't price directly.

Place and confirm orders. Place purchase orders, pass along the print-ready files from our art team, and confirm ship dates.

Chase early. Track every outsourced job to delivery, and follow up with vendors before deadlines, not after.

Check what arrives. Inspect outsourced work on arrival, and handle vendor errors, reprints and credits.

Protect the margin. Buy at or under the cost used in the quote.

Protect confidentiality. Vendor requests carry job specs only, never customer details, and white-label orders ship blind.

Own the vendor list. Keep vendor contacts, pricing and strengths up to date.

Production calendar and order flow

Every order moves through the same stages. Our art team owns the artwork and proofs. You keep each order on the production calendar with a current stage, next step and due date, and move it along as it progresses:



Artwork and proof (art team)

Customer approval

Production, in-house or at a vendor

Finishing and quality check

Shipping, delivery or pickup

Pass artwork between teams. Take approved, print-ready art from the art team and hand it to whoever is printing it, in-house or at a vendor. When a printer flags a problem, such as art too blurry for the ordered size, send it back to the art team with what is needed. You don't design or fix artwork.

Sweep daily. Find anything stuck, late or missing a date, and fix it that day.

Run rush orders. Prioritize rush jobs and balance the in-house production team's workload.

Coordinate delivery. Arrange shipping, local delivery and pickup across Austin, Houston and Dallas.

Run the daily huddle. Meet with production and customer service every day to set priorities.

What success looks like

Success means orders arrive when we said they would, and customers never hear about a problem from anyone but you. The targets below are suggested starting points; adjust them before posting.



What you bring



Must have

3 or more years in print production coordination, print buying or brokering, or promotional products customer service

Working knowledge of print: digital and offset printing, large format and signs, promotional products and apparel

Enough print-file know-how to spot and relay problems, such as art too low in resolution for the print size; you won't design or fix artwork

Experience buying from trade printers or suppliers and holding them to deadlines

Clear, fast writing: most customer and vendor contact is by
 and chat

Strong organization: you track dozens of open jobs at once without dropping one

Comfort with web-based tools: order systems, a CRM or help desk, Google Workspace



Nice to have

Experience with trade printers and wholesale suppliers

Promotional products sourcing through ASI or SAGE

HubSpot, WooCommerce or QuickBooks

Experience leading or training a small customer service team

Experience with corporate purchasing: purchase orders, approvals and recurring orders

title: EXPERIENCED EDITOR — LONG-TERM FREELANCE  ($1,000+ USD/// LONG-TERM 2X, 3X)
description:
PLEASE READ ALL REQUIREMENTS BEFORE APPLYING



We're looking for one experienced, dependable editor who wants to grow into a larger creative production role over the next 1–2 years, ideally much longer.



This position starts with straightforward audio editing, but that's only the first stage. Our goal is to gradually transfer more of the production process to someone who demonstrates excellent judgment, consistency, and independence.



Our current production budget reaches $1,000/month for broader responsibilities, with the possibility of substantially higher compensation as we grow. However, we don't expect to hand over everything immediately, regardless of experience.



Our unique compensation structure rewards increasing independence and progressively reduces the need for our involvement over a realistic timeline. We're investing in a long-term working relationship, not simply hiring someone to complete isolated tasks.



The payoff with a unique role like this is once you learn the style and flow, the work itself is very easy and consistent with a lot of flexibility for the pay amount. However, it's not meant for a majority of freelancers, since it's a difficult starting process and expectation upfront to learn. 



So, if you're someone who can tolerate initial difficulty to reach a satisfying reward, read on. 

(If not, this long/particular/detailed post is meant to filter you out as this is not a role for you)



----------------------------------------------------------------------



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



• English: C2 (Mastery) or native/bilingual proficiency. Excellent comprehension of conversational English, humor, and nuance. Supporting evidence required.



• Experience: Verifiable podcast or spoken-audio editing experience, including precise dialogue cuts, crossfades, and natural-sounding transitions.



• Software: Experience with DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional editing software. CapCut-only experience does not qualify. All assignments will use DaVinci Resolve.



• Reliability: Proven history of meeting deadlines, communicating consistently, and maintaining long-term client relationships.



This is NOT an entry-level position. Applicants must demonstrate relevant professional experience.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



OUR CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION



Our videos explore astrology, tarot, spirituality, energy work, sound healing, and other esoteric or pseudoscientific subjects.

Your personal relationship with these topics matters to us and this application.



Eventually, you'll need to understand the concepts well enough to identify opportunities for humor, visual storytelling, and creative emphasis. That requires more than simply following editing instructions.



We're looking for someone who genuinely respects and finds value in the material, not someone willing to tolerate it for a paycheck. Over time, a lack of respect for the subject matter can develop into frustration or disengagement, affecting both creative quality and the working relationship.



We want to understand how you personally feel about these subjects because your long-term interest and motivation are important to the success of this role.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



STARTING WORK & DEADLINES (AUDIO ONLY): 



Starting assignments typically include 1–2 videos weekly, averaging 20–30 minutes each. Volume and video length vary, and no minimum number of assignments is guaranteed.



• Removing filler words, mistakes, and unnecessary pauses

• Cleaning distracting breaths and awkward transitions

• Using precise cuts and crossfades to preserve natural speech



No visual editing is required at this stage.



You'll receive detailed instructional materials, examples, and project specifications. Training focuses on learning our established workflow, not basic editing fundamentals.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



TURNAROUND REQUIREMENTS



• 1 video: Within 24 hours

• 2 videos: Within 48 hours



Assignments are communicated in advance, generally midweek. You will never be expected to do a 24 hour return out of nowhere. Deadlines begin upon receiving complete project materials.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION & QUALITY STANDARDS (STAGE 1: LEARNING)



Paid trial: $20 for one 20–30-minute video.

Following a successful trial, audio-only assignments are paid according to the accuracy of the original submission:



• 0–4 revision notes: $40/video

• 5–20 revision notes: $30/video

• 21+ revision notes: $20/video



These rates apply only to the initial audio-cleanup responsibilities. This revision process is not meant to last forever, just until you demonstrate independence to move on to the next stage. 



----------------------------------------------------------------------



ASSIGNMENT & PAYMENT PROCESS 



1. Submit: Review your work before delivery and invoice for the $20 base payment.

2. Review: We evaluate your original submission within 2–4 calendar days and identify errors against our instructions.

3. Learn: You'll receive your submitted version alongside our finalized edit. Study the differences and
 a brief summary of what you learned and what you'll apply going forward.

4. Final Payment: Invoice for any remaining quality bonus after completing your review acknowledgment.



Revision notes count editing errors or missed documented requirements, not new creative requests.



LATE DELIVERY DEDUCTIONS (BONUSES ONLY)



• Up to 5 hours late: $5 deduction

• More than 5–12 hours late: $10 deduction

• More than 12–24 hours late: $15 deduction

• Over 24 hours late: No bonus; $20 base only



Deductions never reduce the guaranteed base payment.



Consistent improvement is expected. Repeated mistakes, missed deadlines, or failure to apply previous feedback may result in ending the working relationship.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



LONG-TERM CREATIVE GROWTH (STAGE 2) 



Once you consistently produce accurate audio edits with minimal supervision, we'll begin expanding your responsibilities.

The next stage involves adding simple creative enhancements to videos that are otherwise already assembled:



• Sound effects, GIFs, text, and humor

• Simple animations and visual callouts

• Small creative additions that strengthen the message or improve audience understanding



You are not creating an entire video from scratch, it is already established. The technical tasks themselves are relatively straightforward.. The difficult part is developing the judgment to know WHERE an element belongs, WHY it adds something, and WHEN it's better to leave something alone.



Our editing style is specific. Even experienced editors will need time to study it, understand our humor and storytelling, and develop that judgment through feedback.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



EARNING POTENTIAL - NOW



Stage 1 — Audio editing

$20–$40 per video, based on accuracy.



Stage 2 — Audio + creative enhancements

Up to $75 per video, or $150 for a two-video assignment, with consistently excellent work and minimal revisions.



Stage 3 — Expanded production responsibilities

Up to $250 per weekly assignment, potentially shorts creation, scriptwriting, and other creative tasks.



Much of this work is already templated. The focus is on adding finishing details, creative enhancements, and independent judgment rather than developing every project from scratch.



Our current maximum budget is approximately $1,000 over four weeks when the workload and responsibilities justify it. Compensation remains assignment-based, not a guaranteed monthly retainer.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



FUTURE EARNINGS  ($2 - 3,000 per month) 



Based on our current revenue growth, we believe the production budget could eventually support $2,000–$3,000 per month over the next few years, provided the workload, business growth, and responsibilities justify it. 



Rather than hiring five different people, we'd prefer to develop one versatile, reliable editor who can gradually take ownership of more of the production process.That requires patience, continuous learning, and mutual trust. In return, we're willing to invest substantially in someone who proves they can take on increasing responsibilities.



We also want compensation to remain an open conversation. As responsibilities expand, new rates will be discussed and agreed upon before additional work is assigned.



We're looking for someone confident enough to communicate directly, raise concerns early, and work through difficult situations rather than avoid them. We value people who can propose solutions, negotiate reasonable compromises, and approach problems constructively.



So please only apply if you truly feel you don't enjoy the process of looking for new work every month or week.



This is the type of role that fits a freelancer who **doesn't** enjoy jumping around between gigs/jobs and wants stability and ease as a payoff in the future. If you feel you enjoy changing employers/roles often, you're probably not a strong fit. 



----------------------------------------------------------------------



TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL FIVE QUESTIONS



1. RELIABILITY

Provide verifiable examples of recurring client work, including the duration of those relationships and your delivery history. How would your current workload allow you to consistently meet our 24–48-hour deadlines over the next 1–2 years or longer? What genuinely interests you about building a long-term working relationship?



2. ENGLISH

Confirm your C2 or native/bilingual proficiency and provide evidence supporting your level of comprehension.



3. EXPERIENCE

Share examples of podcast or spoken-audio editing you've personally completed. Explain your responsibilities, software used, and what specific editing work you performed.



4. CONTENT COMPATIBILITY

What is your personal experience with astrology, tarot, spirituality, energy work, sound healing, or similar subjects? How do you honestly feel about these topics, and could you see yourself enjoying creative work involving them for several years?



We're interested in your actual perspective, including reservations. We'd rather discover an incompatibility now than after both sides have invested substantial time and effort.



5. PROBLEM-SOLVING

Describe a real situation where a client relationship, assignment, or workload became difficult or overwhelming and you had to fix it independently. What happened, how did you handle it, and what was the outcome? We're particularly interested in how you communicate and solve problems when things don't go according to plan or expectation. 



START DATE: JANUARY 1, 2027

title: Medior Funnelbuilder for health and beauty brand
description:
Medior Funnel Builder — Vitaronne (DTC Beauty, Québec /Chile Market)



Role: Medior Funnel Builder

Brand: Vitaronne — premium beauty & skincare, direct-to-consumer (DTC)

Market: French-speaking Canada (Québec)/ Spanish Chile 

Engagement: Fixed-price project-based (milestone payments)

Location: Remote (OnlineJobs.ph platform)



About Vitaronne



Vitaronne is a European-operated DTC brand selling premium beauty and skincare products to the Québec market. We run a Meta ads → landing page → Shopify checkout → post-purchase flow ecosystem. All copy is in Québec French; all campaigns comply with Canadian cosmetic and consumer protection law.



The Role



You will design, build, and optimize sales funnels that convert cold traffic into customers and drive repeat revenue. Your core deliverables are:



Advertorial funnel pages (Funnelish): lead-capture landing pages designed around Meta ads campaigns

Post-purchase upsell flows (ReConvert): 1-click offer + downsell + thank-you page sequences

Checkout optimization: Shopify checkout pages, field streamlining, trust signals


 funnel coordination: work with Klaviyo flow sequences to nurture post-purchase customers

Testing & iteration: A/B test copy, layout, CTA placement, and conversion paths; report lift via screenshots/analytics

What You'll Build

Landing pages that match advertorial formats (no dark patterns; transparent "Publireportage" disclosure per Québec law)

Post-purchase checkout flows with cosmetic-only claims (no efficacy statements)

Multi-step funnels that guide cold prospects → product buyer → repeat customer

Conversion-optimized pages using copywriting, layout design, form psychology, and social proof

Success Metrics

Page load speed 

Comfortable with Meta ads ecosystem: understand pixel events, retargeting, funnel attribution

Strong copywriting or copywriting collaboration: can write or brief compelling funnel copy

A/B testing mindset: comfortable testing, measuring, and iterating on conversion metrics

Attention to compliance: can follow checklists (e.g., no false scarcity, no pre-ticked upsells, explicit copy guardrails)

Proactive communicator: deliver work with progress screenshots, status updates, and rationale behind choices

Nice to Have

Experience with Klaviyo
 flows or post-purchase automation

DTC / e-commerce background (beauty, skincare, supplements, health)

Familiarity with ROAS tracking and basic conversion analytics

French-Canadian language skills (helpful for understanding audience nuance, not required)

We Don't Need

Designers (we handle brand visuals)

Copy specialists (you work within approved copy or we provide translated drafts)

Growth strategists (your job is execution, not strategy)

How We Work

Milestone-gated payments: each deliverable is approved and paid upon completion and review

First deliverable = proof of concept: initial project is scoped small to validate quality before scaling

Fixed-price contracts: price per funnel, per month, or per milestone (we discuss scope first)

Direct feedback: you'll receive specific, actionable notes; we communicate in English

Tool stack: Shopify, Funnelish, ReConvert, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, ClickUp (project tracking)

What We're Looking For Right Now



We need a reliable funnel builder who can:



Build an advertorial landing page in Funnelish that converts cold Meta traffic (beauty/skincare vertical)

Design a post-purchase upsell flow in ReConvert with 1-click offer + downsell + thank-you page

Coordinate with Klaviyo flows to hand off
 sequences post-checkout

Follow compliance checklists (French-Canadian copy, no false claims, Publireportage disclosure, CASL footer)

Report results: share conversion data, A/B test recommendations, and next-step priorities

Application & Test Task



If your background matches, we'll send a small test project (single landing page or post-purchase flow, fixed price). This is your opportunity to show quality and communication style. Successful test tasks often lead to ongoing retainer work.



Key Details

Scope: start with 1–2 funnel builds, then scale to ongoing optimization and testing

Timeline: expect 2–3 week turnaround per funnel from briefing to live

Communication: async via
, ClickUp comments, and occasional Zoom calls

Payment: fixed price per milestone, paid upon approval (PayPal or Wise)

How to Apply



Reply with:



Your 3 best funnel examples (links to live funnels or case study screenshots)

Tools you've used: list Funnelish, ReConvert, Shopify, Klaviyo experience (or similar)

DTC/e-commerce background: how many years and which verticals

One sentence on why you're interested in Vitaronne

Filter word: The word that best describes successful funnel optimization (look for it in the job post)



We'll review carefully and reach out to strong candidates within 48–72 hours.



Why Vitaronne

Real DTC traction: we're not testing; we're scaling a brand with real customer acquisition and retention

Compliance-first mindset: you'll learn to build funnels within legal guardrails, a skill valuable across markets

Long-term partnership: strong test-task performers often become ongoing retainer team members

Clear success metrics: you'll see ROAS, conversion rate, and customer feedback — no vanity metrics



Let's build something.

s

title: Video Editor for Products Ads
description:
Join Our Creative Team as a Video Editor!

We’re looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and innovative Video Editor to help us create engaging product videos that capture attention and drive results. This is a long-term opportunity for a professional editor passionate about storytelling, brand alignment, and using cutting-edge tools.



What You’ll Do:

Research and Source Content: Find and integrate relevant footage, B-rolls, and visuals from platforms like YouTube, Instagram, and stock libraries.

Edit High-Quality Videos: Create professional, engaging ads and social media content using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, and AI tools like Runway AI.

Showcase Product Benefits: Use creative transitions, text overlays, and animations to highlight features and tell compelling stories.

Optimize for Platforms: Tailor content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube to ensure maximum engagement.

Collaborate on Scripts: Work closely with the team to align your edits with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.



What You’ll Get:

Competitive Pay: We value your skills and offer performance-based incentives.

Upskilling Opportunities: Learn and work with innovative AI tools and advanced editing techniques.

Creative Growth: Collaborate with a dynamic team and gain experience working on impactful, high-visibility projects.

Long-Term Role: Join a supportive environment where your work makes a difference and your growth is prioritized.



What We’re Looking For:

Proven Experience: A strong portfolio showcasing:

B-roll integration and creative storytelling.

AI-enhanced edits and motion graphics.

Short-form and product-focused content.

Technical Skills: Expertise in tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, and Canva; experience with AI tools is a bonus.

Platform Expertise: Strong understanding of platform-specific video requirements (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

Content Research Skills: Ability to find and source relevant content online to elevate projects.

Creativity and Attention to Detail: A creative mindset with the ability to ensure videos align with brand guidelines.

Team Player: Ability to collaborate effectively and contribute to a supportive team environment.



How to Apply:

To be considered, send us:



Your Current Employment Details: Share where you are currently employed, your role, and what you do. If you work with multiple clients or companies, include that information as well.

Your Portfolio featuring:

Product videos or ads.

Creative use of B-rolls and stock footage.

AI-enhanced edits or unique transitions.



Answers to These Questions:

Share a project from your portfolio that you’re most proud of and why.

How do you source B-rolls, stock footage, or content for your edits?

Which editing tools do you primarily use, and why?

How do you handle situations with limited or low-quality footage?

What’s a challenging project you worked on, and how did you resolve it?

Special Word: Include the word CREATOR in your application to show you’ve read the details.

Special Note

This role is perfect for editors who are passionate about creating content that stands out, love solving creative challenges, and want to grow with a supportive, forward-thinking team.



Apply now and start your journey with us! Let’s create something amazing together.

This role goes far beyond making content that looks good. Design high-converting static image advertisements.

Knowledge of

What Success Looks Like
